newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks quietly higher in London trading.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks quietly higher in London trading.

text.p: Japanese stocks edged higher in London trading on Monday amid selected buying of blue chips such as Fujitsu and Mitsubishi and a firm opening on Wall Street, traders here said.
The Nikkei 50 index of leading Japanese stocks traded in London was up 1.77 points or 0.12 percent at 1,471.96, extending a cautious 9.38-point gain in the Nikkei 225 index in Japan earlier today.
"It has been pretty quiet but there have been a few buyers of blue chips," said one trader at a Japanese securities house.
He said stocks had also gained support from weekend press comment that the dollar could add to recent strength against the yen.
Traders said Japanese stocks could extend the rally that has run since the start of September, before falling victim to profit-taking.

"Possibly we will squeeze a bit more out," said the trader, "then it will be time to have a little rethink and take some profits." Said another: "There is still some support for the market...but I think a lot of stocks are looking pretty overbought."
